description: Start a run from an .athdf file: one Shaderous wrote continues exactly; another code’s is loaded into the current problem. Paused at the file’s time.

one_field.description: With view: hold only the field shown (true) or the state (false), instead of whichever keeps more levels

view.description: Open it only to look at (a run too large to continue here): read in parts, never stepped (run refuses), held with its state or holding only the field shown (baked from the file again when the field changes), whichever keeps more levels, its finest levels merged until it fits the GPU memory budget. probe, screenshot and view work; slice and stats need the state. The result says the level kept and the mode (`view`)

name: load_athdf
